description: introduce the Supervisor–Lead–Peers workspace contract while preserving QiQi as the Lead runtime name: add an independent Supervisor policy and shared WORKSPACE_PROTOCOL, make repository children explicit Peers with independent REOPEN_REQUEST/DEPENDENCY_REQUEST/BLOCKED signals, require explicit Lead disposition for actionable Peer responses, enforce sibling-repository isolation in the rendered peer handoff so provenance does not become filesystem authority, and extend workspace/repository checkers to enforce the SLP role boundaries
